name: Venomancer: Shadra's Seance, Black Widow and Serpent Lord's Ring act natively (#1721, #1922, #1905)
contract: #1721 Shadra's Seance (300678): effect 0 is SPELLMOD_DURATION (aura 107, op 1) +6000 and effect 1 SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME (aura 108, op 19) -20%, both with mask (0,0,0x10000) = every Facemelter rank (800871, 502877-502880, 572900-572903). Aura::CalcMaxDuration applies op 1 and AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodic (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:718) applies op 19, so Facemelter (Duration index 8 = 15000 ms, amplitude 3000) becomes 21000 ms and 2400 ms. #1922 Black Widow (504322): effect 0 is SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 (aura 107, op 23) -20 with mask (0,0x20000000,0), matching Widow's Kiss aura 804118 whose effect 2 is aura 108 SPELLMOD_COST with base 0 and mask (0,0x4000,0) = Venom Fang; Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers turns that 0 into -20, so Venom Fang's 35 energy becomes 28. Effect 1 (aura 154, stealth level) has no harness metric and is not asserted. #1905 Serpent Lord's Ring (503923): effect 0 SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN (op 11) -100% and effect 1 SPELLMOD_COST (op 14) -100% with mask (0,0x20,0) = every Mycosis rank (804986, 572150-572156, 573355), and effect 2 SPELL_EFFECT_ENERGIZE_PCT of 20 on mana. Mycosis carries its 15000 ms as a CategoryRecoveryTime (category 113), which Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns also passes through SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN; the modifier is probed with base 15000. The Ring's effects 0 and 1 are only active in the 15 s buff it grants, so the Ring is really cast. Each probe compares against an unmodified control or against a baseline taken in the same run, so the scenario fails if a passive stops working. The mana check is a lower bound (20% of a pool that setup asserts is at least 100000): the harness cannot compare an energize total with the pool directly. No source or SQL change is involved.
